svg.title: Illustrative top view of the RenewableSwitchOver Arduino shield, drawn from its schematic
svg.text: The RenewableSwitchOver shield (illustration from the schematic)
Top view, to scale on an Arduino Uno outline: the USB and power jacks are underneath on the left.
MEC1019 · shield for Arduino Uno R3
Parts and nets are the schematic's; their positions are an illustration, grouped by function. The real board's layout may differ.
Default jumper positions shown: JP1 and JP2 on direct drive, JP3 and JP4 bridged. Silkscreen pin labels follow the Uno R3.
